messages:
Alice Chen: Heads up — Received a DSAR requesting deletion of user material across eu-west1 and us-west2. Current deletion-worker cannot call the customer's KMS alias unlink because the service account lacks cryptoKeyVersion delete permissions. Proposing a time-limited RBAC change: custom 'keystore-deleter' role scoped to project for deletion-worker. Any blockers?

Mateo Ruiz: Oof. We've intentionally avoided granting delete on cryptoKeyVersions. Can we instead rotate the alias to a null target + mark vectors deleted in the DB? That avoids touching key material.

Priya Kapoor: Legal preference is full deletion when available. If we can't physically destroy key material due to KMS constraints, we need a documented retention exception and evidence of attempted deletion + proof that the material is inaccessible.

Jamal Brooks: FYI there's a logging bug in deletion-worker I found — it currently logs vector IDs and requestor_id in plaintext. If we escalate RBAC to allow deletes, audit trails will include requestor info; we must redact or fix logs first. I'll open a PR to redact requestor_id.

Zoe Park: Granting roles/cloudkms.admin is too broad. I can craft a custom role with only the necessary perms (cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.destroy or delete depending on API + iam.get on project). I'll prepare the role and a temporary IAM binding; will post the policy snippet here.

Alice Chen: Also need structured audit entries for the action: fields = actor, action=keystore_unlink, key_version, request_ts, dsar_id, rationale. Can we index these into internal keystore_audit index and mark dsar evidence entries specially?

Elena (sec PM): Confirmed — compliance requires audit evidence retention for 7 years; DSAR deletion evidence can be tagged and stored for 3 years if legal approves. We'll require encryption with org-level KMS and an immutable tag. No objections to a time-limited role as long as approvals are recorded.

Priya Kapoor: If we go with a temporary elevated role, Legal needs explicit approval email thread and the retention exception doc linked. Also require the action to be captured in our DSAR ticket with timestamps and witnesses.

Mateo Ruiz: I'll draft the terraform + scheduler TTL for auto-revocation. Draft snippet below, will iterate:
```hcl
resource "google_project_iam_binding" "dsar_keystore_deleter" {
  project = var.project
  role    = "roles/customKeystoreDeleter"
  members = ["serviceAccount:deletion-worker@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com"]
}
# Cloud Scheduler job to remove binding after 24h
```

Jamal Brooks: Opened GH issue #4876 for the logging redaction. Assigning to @jamal. Will block the deletion job until redaction PR is merged + custom role is in place.

AuditBot: New audit rule 'keystore_unlink' created by Zoe Park (policy-id: ar-2026-09-16).

Alice Chen: TL;DR: Zoe to create custom role + temp binding + policy; Mateo to submit terraform PR and scheduler; Jamal to fix logging and hold deletion; Priya/Legal to sign retention exception + evidence checklist; Elena to confirm audit index tagging and encryption. We'll reconvene after PRs and approvals. :thumbsup:
